events.detail_full_zh: 受地震影响，此前曾采取停运措施，但截至07:00已恢复运行。目前，部分列车出现晚点或停运情况。
events.detail_full_en: Due to the effects of the earthquake, services were suspended, but as of 07:00, the resumption of services is now in effect. Please note that there are currently train delays and service suspensions.
